_comment: Source text of the localized landing pages (tools/site_lang.mjs → server/<lang>/index.html). English is the reference; the English page itself is server/index.html. Only <b> is allowed inside strings; {store} becomes the Chrome Web Store link.
title: Free ad blocker for Chrome — Supreme AdBlock
description: Supreme AdBlock blocks YouTube ads, banners, pop-ups, trackers and cookie banners in Chrome. Free, no account; your browsing stays on your device.
lead: Supreme AdBlock blocks ads everywhere — YouTube video ads, banners, pop-ups and trackers — without watching what you do.
where: For Chrome, Edge and Brave (version 121 or newer). The extension speaks your language.
verifiedSmall: Verified on the Chrome Web Store, no history of violations
features: Video, feed and search ads are taken out of the player's data before the player reads it, so videos simply play.
EasyList, EasyPrivacy and the uBlock Origin filters are built in, plus 31 regional lists; the one for your language turns on by itself.
Hidden in the Facebook, Instagram and Threads feeds; your friends' posts stay.
It presses Reject when the banner offers it, and Accept only when there is no other way to close it; it clears the leftover blur and scroll lock and never presses a sign-in, OAuth or payment button.
Trackers, tracking parameters in links and pop-up ad windows are blocked; anti-adblock walls are neutralised.
Hide chat bubbles, newsletter pop-ups, notification prompts, AI pop-ups and YouTube Shorts, only if you want to.
Every site you visit is asked not to sell or share your data.
Bring your allowed sites and filters from uBlock Origin, AdGuard or Adblock Plus with one file.
privacyTitle: Your browsing stays on your device
privacyText: Filtering happens in your browser. No account, no analytics, no telemetry. The only automatic request to us is a signed filter update about twice a day, and it carries no data about you. We take no money from advertisers and let no ad through for a fee.
install: Open Supreme AdBlock on the {store} and choose Add to Chrome. It works the same way in Edge and Brave.
Reload the tabs that were already open.
Browse as usual. The popup shows what was blocked on the page.
faq: Yes. It is free, with no account and no paid tier. Donations are optional and never required.
Yes. Video ads never start, and the ads in the feed and search are removed too. Ads that YouTube stitches into the video stream on its servers cannot be removed by any extension.
No. Your browsing data never leaves your device. The filter update reaches our server in the EU like any download, and that request is not logged.
Rarely. If a site misbehaves, choose “Site broken?” in the popup: one click fixes it, or allows ads there for an hour.
Does it work with Manifest V3?
Yes. It was written for Manifest V3, Chrome's current extension platform, from the first line.
Is it an alternative to uBlock Origin or AdGuard?
Yes, as a Chrome extension. In Settings you can bring over your allowed sites and your own filters from either of them, or from Adblock Plus.
finalText: Free on the Chrome Web Store, for Chrome, Edge and Brave.
